_comment: GitHub Copilot CLI hooks. Save as <repo>/.github/hooks/agent-observer.json. Replace AGENT_ID and the host. `bash` runs on Linux/macOS, `powershell` on Windows; both always exit 0 so an unreachable device never denies a tool call. Hooks send only the event name, plus the tool name (tool/permission events) or the notification type (notifications), extracted locally from the hook JSON; the payload itself (prompts, tool input/output, paths, messages) is never sent.

preToolUse.bash: v=$(grep -o '"tool_*[nN]ame" *: *"[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]*' | head -n 1 | sed 's/.*"//' | cut -c 1-40); curl -s -m 2 --connect-timeout 1 -X POST "http://agent-observer.local/api/hook/AGENT_ID?event=preToolUse&tool=$v" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
preToolUse.powershell: $v=''; if (($input | Out-String) -match '"tool_?name"\s*:\s*"([A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{1,40})') { $v=$Matches[1] }; curl.exe -s -m 2 --connect-timeout 1 -X POST "http://agent-observer.local/api/hook/AGENT_ID?event=preToolUse&tool=$v" | Out-Null; exit 0

permissionRequest.bash: v=$(grep -o '"tool_*[nN]ame" *: *"[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]*' | head -n 1 | sed 's/.*"//' | cut -c 1-40); curl -s -m 2 --connect-timeout 1 -X POST "http://agent-observer.local/api/hook/AGENT_ID?event=permissionRequest&tool=$v" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
permissionRequest.powershell: $v=''; if (($input | Out-String) -match '"tool_?name"\s*:\s*"([A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{1,40})') { $v=$Matches[1] }; curl.exe -s -m 2 --connect-timeout 1 -X POST "http://agent-observer.local/api/hook/AGENT_ID?event=permissionRequest&tool=$v" | Out-Null; exit 0

notification.bash: v=$(grep -o '"notification_*[tT]ype" *: *"[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]*' | head -n 1 | sed 's/.*"//' | cut -c 1-40); curl -s -m 2 --connect-timeout 1 -X POST "http://agent-observer.local/api/hook/AGENT_ID?event=notification&ntype=$v" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
notification.powershell: $v=''; if (($input | Out-String) -match '"notification_?type"\s*:\s*"([A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{1,40})') { $v=$Matches[1] }; curl.exe -s -m 2 --connect-timeout 1 -X POST "http://agent-observer.local/api/hook/AGENT_ID?event=notification&ntype=$v" | Out-Null; exit 0
